lock.title: KassaLite is locked
lock.body: Unlock with Face ID to see your purchases.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyBody: Pay with Apple Pay. Each purchase appears here a moment after the Shortcut sends it.

pair.title: Pair KassaLite
pair.intro: In the full Kassa app or on the web, open Settings → Pair KassaLite and scan the QR code, or type the 8-character code here.
pair.invalidCode: The code has 8 letters and digits.
pair.invalidServer: Enter the server address, starting with https://.
pair.failed: Pairing failed. The code may have expired (it lasts 2 minutes): create a new one.
pair.noTokens: The server did not return a session. Try a new code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shortcutIntro: An iOS Shortcut sends every Apple Pay purchase to your Kassa server. Set it up once; this card turns green when it works.

setup.statusOkHeard: Last heard from it {{time}}. Pay with Apple Pay and the purchase appears in Activity.
setup.waitingPay: Waiting for your first Apple Pay purchase…

copy.title: Copy your setup
copy.bodyTemplate: Your server address and private key, in two lines. Shortcuts asks for them in the next step.
copy.bodyManual: You paste these two values into the automation in the next step.
copy.noToken: No Shortcut key on this iPhone. Sign out and pair again.

add.title: Add the Kassa Shortcut
add.body: Shortcuts opens. Tap Add Shortcut and, when it asks, paste the setup you copied.

automate.title: Run it on every Apple Pay tap
automate.body: In Shortcuts: Automation → + → Transaction. Pick your Wallet cards, choose Run Immediately, then Next → New Blank Automation. Add “Run Shortcut”, pick Kassa, tap › and set Input to Shortcut Input.

build.title: Create the automation
build.body: About two minutes in the Shortcuts app. Keep this screen open to copy the values.

steps.1: Open Shortcuts → Automation → + → Transaction. Pick your Wallet cards, choose Run Immediately, then Next → New Blank Automation.
steps.2: Add “Get Contents of URL”. URL: tap Copy URL above and paste. Tap › and set Method to POST.
steps.3: Headers: add Authorization; for its value tap Copy key above and paste (it starts with “Bearer ”).
steps.4: Request Body: JSON with merchant = Shortcut Input › Merchant, amount = Shortcut Input › Amount, card = Shortcut Input › Card or Pass. Optional: add “Get Current Location” first and send street, city and country, so the notification says where you paid.
steps.5: Add “Get Dictionary Value” (key nudge) and “Show Notification” with that value. Tap Done.

test.title: Test it
test.bodyTemplate: Runs the Shortcut once without a purchase. You see a “Kassa is connected” notification and this card turns green.
test.bodyManual: Checks that this iPhone reaches your server with the key. Then pay with Apple Pay once: this card turns green when the purchase arrives.
test.serverOk: Server and key work. Last step: pay with Apple Pay once, a coffee is enough.
test.success: It works! Your Apple Pay purchases now show up in Activity.
test.revoked: The server refused the key: it was revoked or belongs to another server. Sign out and pair again.
test.unreachable: This iPhone cannot reach {{host}}. Check that the server (and its tunnel) is running and the address is right.
test.failed: The server answered, but not as Kassa. Check the server address.
test.timeout: Kassa did not hear from the Shortcut. Check that it is named “Kassa”, that you pasted the setup when Shortcuts asked, and that Shortcuts may run it (allow it if iOS asks).

settings.noShortcutToken: No Shortcut token stored. Pair this iPhone again.
settings.serverFooter: Must be a stable https address, for example your named tunnel. Changing it does not re-pair: sign out and pair again if the server is different.
settings.signOutBody: The tokens on this iPhone are deleted. The Shortcut keeps working until you revoke it in the full app.
settings.updatesOff: Over-the-air updates are off in this build. Rebuild it from Xcode after setting the EAS project id (docs/OTA_UPDATES.md).
settings.updatesDebug: Debug build: the app loads from Metro and ignores updates. Run the Release configuration.
settings.updatesInfo: Channel {{channel}}, app version {{runtime}}. Updates only reach builds with the same channel and version.
settings.updatesEmbeddedHint: No over-the-air update applied yet. A new one downloads when the app opens and applies when it restarts.

approve.opened: Approve this in the Kassa web app. KassaLite cannot use a passkey.
approve.backHint: Approved. You can go back to KassaLite now.

pairDevice.rowHint: Link a second iPhone that logs Apple Pay purchases
pairDevice.title: Pair KassaLite
pairDevice.intro: On the iPhone with KassaLite, scan this QR code with the camera or type the code. The code works once.
